added_descriptive_analysis: Registered after the main protocol and before inspecting any new rollout payoff; no new games or tuning.
cards: Use every included original deal with equal weights within each of the three fixed seeds, then give each seed equal weight.
policies: The 480 distribution and the uniform arithmetic mean of the normalized 486/492/498/504 distributions at the first designated hero flop decision.
mass: For each action group, report mean baseline and mixture probability and mixture minus baseline in percentage points. Count zero at states lacking a given action.
value: For each original deal and frozen opponent field, compute eight-runout mean Q_a in big blinds for each positive-support concrete action. Let V_480 be the sum of baseline probability times the same Q_a. Group contribution = sum over distinct concrete actions in the group of (p_mixture[a] - p_480[a]) * (Q_a - V_480).
outputs: All four groups, all three continuation fields, per-field reconciliation to the preregistered primary effect. Point estimates are descriptive accounting, scoped to 480-reached flops with common downstream hero. No hypothesis tests, no subgroup or candidate selection. No dealing, policy update or promotion.
